instruction: Play this streaming video URL in VLC: https://test-streams.mux.dev/x36xhzz/x36xhzz.m3u8

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires streaming a different HLS URL in VLC. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric which checks VLC status XML for the expected URL. Similar complexity to original task.
metadata.verification_notes: Reuses existing VLC evaluator functions. The is_vlc_playing metric handles URL matching including HLS streams.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC playing status via HTTP interface status.xml
Metric properly checks both playing state and URL matching with comprehensive logic
Metric handles HLS streams correctly - checks full URL, filename-only match (common for HLS), and domain/path matching
Expected value is semantically correct - URL matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage - verifies both that VLC is playing AND the correct URL is loaded
Correct parameter handling - metric function receives rules dict directly as 'rule' parameter (not 'expected'), correctly accesses rule['type'] and rule['url']
Data flow is correct: getter saves status.xml → metric reads file → checks state and URL → returns score
